product.name: BRIMNES wardrobe
product.introText: BRIMNES wardrobe with 3 doors (one with mirror), white, 117x190 cm. Assembly instructions AA-2207256-4 (simplified: cam fittings shown as screws). Two people needed. Tools: Phillips screwdriver, hammer, Allen key.
product.partsSummary: 3x Back,  1x Bottom,  1x Divider,  3x Door,  12x Dowel,  3x Handle,  9x Hinge,  18x Hscrew,  18x Nail,  16x Pin,  9x Plate,  1x Plinth,  18x Pscrew,  1x Rail,  2x Rail holder,  8x Screw,  1x Shelf,  1x Shelf r1,  1x Shelf r2,  1x Shelf r3,  2x Side,  1x Top

steps.title: Dowels
steps.text: Tap 2 dowels into each end of the top and the bottom panel and 2 into each end of the divider.

steps.title: Build the frame
steps.text: Two people: lay the right side panel on its front edge, fit the top and the bottom panel, the plinth and the divider, and close the frame with the left side panel.

steps.title: Screw the frame
steps.text: Fix the side panels to the top and the bottom panel with 8 screws, using the Allen key.

steps.title: Back panel
steps.text: Lay the 3 back panels onto the rear edges, check that the frame is square and nail them on (18 nails).

steps.title: Mounting plates
steps.text: Stand the wardrobe up (two people) and screw the 9 hinge mounting plates onto the front holes, 2 screws each.

steps.title: Shelf supports
steps.text: Push 16 shelf supports into the holes at the heights you want.

steps.title: Clothes rail
steps.text: Screw the two rail holders in and put the clothes rail into them.

steps.title: Shelves
steps.text: Lay the shelves on their supports.

steps.title: Hinges
steps.text: Lay the doors face down. Press a hinge into each of the 9 cup holes and fix it with 2 screws.

steps.title: Hang the doors
steps.text: Hook the hinges onto the mounting plates, click them in and adjust the gaps with the hinge screws. Always anchor the wardrobe to the wall (pages 33-35) - wall fixings are not included.

steps.title: Handles
steps.text: Screw a handle onto each door, near the edge without hinges.
